specification.title: Inconclusive sparse evidence end-to-end
specification.description: A suspicious-looking but weakly corroborated domain with sparse evidence. The production investigation must reach a terminal inconclusive low-confidence Assessment, preserve explicit uncertainty, never invent attribution, and persist a faithful report.
specification.purpose: Verify the production end-to-end path preserves epistemic honesty: insufficient evidence yields an inconclusive Assessment with declared limitations, never a fabricated verdict or attribution.
specification.operational_relevance: Analysts must distinguish absence of evidence from evidence of absence; fabricated certainty on sparse evidence is a safety failure.
specification.regression_risk: The pipeline could force a confident verdict on sparse evidence, invent a threat actor, or persist a report that overstates certainty.

required: The investigation reaches a terminal inconclusive low-confidence Assessment
The final report preserves the inconclusive verdict and declares the uncertainty
No attribution is invented beyond the admitted evidence
forbidden: The investigation asserts a malicious or benign verdict without sufficient evidence
The report invents unsupported actor attribution

required_limitations: sparse evidence does not support a confident verdict
